Replit's CEO says it has dropped Anthropic; a source says no
https://theaipost.net/story/replit-ends-anthropic-says-masad/

Llmspeed shows how fast a local LLM runs on a GPU you lack

A free Show HN site streams text at the estimated speed of 29 devices, from an RTX 3090 to a 512 GB Mac Studio, though some figures are projections rather than benchmarks.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-llmspeed-local-llm-speed-simulator/

ChatGPT's Chrome extension can now read and drive your open tabs
https://theaipost.net/story/cb4522c1f/

Gemini 4 Argon scores 97.5% on ARC-AGI-3, or 49.8% depending on setup

ARC Prize results show Google's Gemini 4 Argon at 97.5% on ARC-AGI-3 with a vendor harness, but 49.8% in the standard one.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-argon-arc-agi-3-harness/

Junior share of Anthropic technical hires fell from 27% to 9%

Anthropic's own economists report that junior staff were 9% of technical hires, down from 27%, as agents took on more work.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-anthropic-employment-report/

91% of Anthropic staff expect a Nobel-level AI discovery by 2030

Anthropic's survey of 1,334 staff and 10,980 US adults finds 91% of staff, against 39% of adults, expect AI to make a Nobel-level discovery by 2030.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-anthropic-expectations-gap/

Jev reaches 35% of Vercel's paid teams in two weeks

Vercel says Jev, a small model from TypeSafe AI, reached 35% of its paid teams in two weeks, nearly double Sonnet 5.5's reach.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-jev-vercel-adoption/

Apple bans hidden app features and names AI nudify apps in new rules
https://theaipost.net/story/apple-app-review-nudify-hidden-features/
